auth.name: Name

home.empty.title: Your library is empty
home.empty.admin: Add a folder with movies or TV shows and Kinema will organise it, fetch posters and get it ready to play.
home.empty.user: The administrator has not added any libraries yet.
home.empty.scanning: Kinema is scanning your folders. New titles appear here as they are found.
library.sort.title: Title
library.empty.title: No titles yet
library.empty.scanning: Scanning the folders. Titles appear here as they are found.
library.empty.message: No video files were found in this library's folders.
library.name: Name
library.hint.movie: One movie per file. Names like “Inception (2010).mkv” or folders like “Inception (2010)/” match best.
library.hint.show: One folder per show, e.g. “Breaking Bad/Season 1/Breaking.Bad.S01E01.mkv”.
library.hint.other: Any videos. Each file is listed by its name.
library.deleteConfirm: Remove the library “{name}”? Your files stay on disk; only Kinema's list and watch history for it are removed.
match.none: No results. Try a shorter title or remove the year.
player.error: This video could not be played in this browser.
player.noFile: This title has no playable file.
player.mode.direct.hint: The original file plays as is.
player.mode.remux.hint: Repackaged for the browser without re-encoding the video.
player.mode.transcode.hint: Converted on the server because this browser cannot decode the original.
settings.title: Settings
settings.noLibraries.title: No libraries
settings.noLibraries.message: Add a folder with your movies or shows to get started.
settings.tmdb.description: Posters, summaries, ratings and episode titles come from The Movie Database (TMDB). Create a free account at themoviedb.org, then paste its API key or read access token here.
settings.tmdb.label: TMDB API key or read access token
settings.tmdb.replace: Paste a new key to replace the current one
settings.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg and ffprobe were not found. Files are listed, but only browser-ready files play and track switching is off. Install ffmpeg or set KINEMA_FFMPEG.
settings.dashboard.name: Name
settings.general.name: Server name
settings.general.nameHint: Shown on the sign-in screen and in the browser tab.
settings.library.watchHint: Uses filesystem events, so an idle server costs no CPU. Turn off for drives that misreport changes, and use Scheduled Tasks instead.
settings.library.thumbnailsHint: Titles without TMDB artwork show a frame from the video. Made in the background, one at a time, after each scan.
settings.library.positionHint: How far into the video the frame is taken. Changing it makes new thumbnails for files that do not have one yet; use Regenerate thumbnails in Libraries to redo the rest.
settings.tmdb.title: The Movie Database
settings.metadata.title: Metadata language
settings.metadata.languageHint: Titles, summaries and episode names in this language when TMDB has them. Applies to new lookups; use Match missing metadata or Fix match to refresh existing titles.
settings.languages.audioHint: The player starts with this audio track when a file has it.
settings.languages.mode.off.hint: Subtitles start off. Viewers can turn them on in the player.
settings.languages.mode.always.hint: Subtitles in the preferred subtitle language start on.
settings.languages.mode.foreign.hint: Subtitles start on only when the audio is not in the preferred audio language.
settings.languages.subtitle: Preferred subtitle language
settings.languages.subtitleHint: With File default, the first text subtitle is used.
settings.transcoder.intro: Most files play directly or are repackaged without re-encoding, which costs almost no CPU. These options apply only when a browser cannot decode the video and the server has to convert it.
settings.transcoder.maxHint: Further viewers who need a conversion are asked to try later. Direct play is never limited.
settings.transcoder.presetHint: Faster presets use less CPU and give larger or slightly worse video.
settings.transcoder.qualityHint: Higher quality sends more data over the network.
settings.transcoder.heightHint: Converted video is scaled down to this height. Never scaled up.
settings.network.listenHint: Set host and port in kinema.toml, then restart the server.
settings.network.urlHint: Use this address on phones, TVs and other computers on the same network.
settings.network.localOnly: The server only accepts connections from this computer. Set host = "0.0.0.0" in kinema.toml to reach it from other devices.
settings.scheduled.rescanHint: For network drives that do not report file changes. Unchanged files are skipped, so a rescan is cheap.
settings.troubleshooting.thumbnailsHint: Made again in the background right away.
settings.troubleshooting.subtitlesHint: Converted again the next time a subtitle is turned on.
settings.troubleshooting.imagesHint: Downloaded again the next time a poster is shown.
